response.sql:
WITH regional AS (
    SELECT
        d.A3 AS region,
        AVG(CASE
                WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
                WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount
            END) AS avg_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
), cross_region_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS mean_avg
    FROM regional
), above_mean AS (
    SELECT r.avg_amount, r.transaction_count, m.mean_avg
    FROM regional AS r
    CROSS JOIN cross_region_mean AS m
    WHERE r.avg_amount > m.mean_avg
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_amount) AS mean_of_above_region_averages,
    AVG(transaction_count) AS mean_transaction_count,
    AVG(avg_amount - mean_avg) AS mean_excess_over_cross_region_mean
FROM above_mean;

assumptions.assumption: A region with no PRIJEM or VYDAJ transactions has no directional average, so its NULL average is excluded from the cross-region mean and from the above-mean regions. All its transactions would still count if it has a defined regional average.
